issues.title: BLU-002 immutable ActivityStep schema — bounded CI evidence

criteria.requirement: Round-trip remains canonical; malformed enum, invalid confidence, unsafe fields and unknown schema fail closed

tests.name: unknown version and extra payload fields fail closed
unknown enum, malformed json and invalid types rejected
confidence must be finite within zero to one
UTC and opaque safe IDs required

criteria.requirement: DTO handles valid and invalid inputs deterministically; cancellation, permissions, offline, restart and timeouts are not applicable to a pure, memory-only value object

tests.name: only canonical millisecond UTC timestamps decode
sub-millisecond timestamps are rejected, not truncated
oversized or deeply nested input is rejected before parsing

criteria.requirement: DTO contains no secret-bearing frame/text/path fields or capture, IO, or executor side effects

tests.name: no capture, IO, or lifecycle side effects in DTO

criteria.requirement: Exact-head flutter analyze, acceptance CI links, PR commands and reviewed evidence
criteria.reason: Acceptance tests and analyzer run in regular CI but a reviewer must tie results and implementation evidence to the exact PR head.

criteria.requirement: Schema version rejection and future migration policy approved for persistent usage
criteria.reason: No deployed prior ActivityStep schema exists; a maintainer must approve the versioned schema contract and future migration policy, independent of basic JSON tests.
